interpretation: Supervised post-document learning scaffold. Does not establish autonomous thought discovery; direct-prediction value is tested separately from generated-computation value.
mechanism: Append a given work header and optionally supervise a prefix-computable trace after the complete original document; no trace precedes or conditions an original-source target.
owner_authorization: Use existing node overnight beyond baselines; finish by08:00Eastern/12:00UTC.
primary: Trace versus matched raw and format direct full527 NLL; positive lower95 interval in both source orders, and trace versus untouched B0, each separately reported. No secondary may rescue a failed primary.
question: Does verified intermediate-computation supervision improve direct natural-text prediction when the original text and every source-token coefficient are preserved?
release_conditions: Complete source/token and CPU loss/gradient causality checks.
Actual native same-shape accumulation/master/reduction/LR and exact recovery qualification.
Measured runtime, RAM snapshot space and available host memory fit remaining overnight envelope.
Freeze the ordinary baseline DEV choice; preserve its independent confirmation.
selection: No treatment checkpoint, seed or arm selection. Report all six terminal models. All freeze before any new confirmation score.

sources.calculation_diagnostic: Existing previously inspected sources, explicitly developmental.

training.objective: Mean per-document original527-token CE plus separately normalized work CE (zero on ordinary examples); source coefficient exactly1/(272*527).
training.optimizer: Same BF16/FP32 AdamW, one reducer, warmup13 and terminal128 checkpoint as baseline.
training.schedule: Freeze the qualified uniform-baseline DEV choice before starting; same LR/schedule in every arm and order.
